name: AICOPYTO (Shenzhen Dayijihe Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Amazon filament brand focused on silk PLA (single, dual, tri-colour and rainbow), plus PLA-CF, TPU 95A and ABS. Its USPTO mark (reg. 7535904, October 2024, Class 17) is owned by Shenzhen Dayijihe Technology Co., Ltd. per an aggregator snippet; the actual manufacturer is unknown.

product_lines.name: Silk PLA (single, dual-color)
product_lines.notes: Bulk of listings; about $14-20/kg; 4 x 1 kg bundles.

product_lines.name: ABS
product_lines.notes: 1 kg cardboard spool, seen on a reseller page.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US; no brand website found. The trademark owner is not shown to be the extruder and no link to a known OEM was found.

provenance.conflicts: Trademark record read on Justia 2026-11-06: AICOPYTO (serial 98275718, filed 2023-11-17, Class 17 filament) applicant Shenzhen Dayijihe Technology Co., Ltd., Huanan International, Shenzhen. Manufacturer and manufacturing country unknown.
